item.title: [breach] 900,000 contact records exposed in Aura data breach
item.description: <p>Aura, the online safety service, confirmed that an unauthorized party accessed about 900,000 records, mostly names and email addresses from a marketing tool linked to a company it acquired in 2021. The incident occurred as a result of a targeted phone phishing attack that tricked one of the employees. Aura believes that contact information related to less than 20,000 active customers and less than 15,000 former customers was accessed. According to Have I Been Pwned, &#8230; <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/19/aura-data-breach-900000-records/" rel="nofollow">More <span class="meta-nav">&#8594;</span></a></p> <p>The post <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/03/19/aura-data-breach-900000-records/">900,000 contact records exposed in Aura data breach</a> appeared first on <a href="https://www.helpnetsecurity.com">Help Net Security</a>.</p>
